name: diacraft
description: Draw and edit diagrams from an agent: flowcharts, org charts and architecture diagrams, in VSDX, ODG and DiaCraft files.
long_description:
DiaCraft is a free, open-source diagram editor. This bundle runs its MCP server (`diacraft-cli mcp`), so an agent can make and change drawings through DiaCraft's commands, and open and save VSDX, ODG and DiaCraft files.

The server starts with no document: ask for a new drawing, or give it the path of a file to open. If the DiaCraft app is running with its control channel on (`diacraft --control 7997`), the server drives that window instead, so what the agent does is what you see. Install the app from https://diacraft.dev to see a drawing in a window.

The bundle holds the DiaCraft command line for this system and CPU. The server can open and write any file the agent names, so give it only to an agent you trust with your files. It connects to nothing but the DiaCraft app on this computer.

tools.name: command_list
tools.description: List DiaCraft's commands with their parameters and whether each can run now.

tools.name: command_run
tools.description: Run one command by id with its parameters.

tools.name: command_batch
tools.description: Run up to 256 commands in order as one undo step, all or nothing.

tools.name: doc_inspect
tools.description: The open document: title, pages, and the undo and redo depth.

tools.name: ui_inspect
tools.description: The state of the DiaCraft window. Needs the app running.

tools.name: ui_screenshot
tools.description: Save the next frame of the DiaCraft window as a PNG. Needs the app running.
